verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Jira's hallmark issue-linking capability ('every issue can be linked to any other issue,' [jira-comm-5]), which supports mapping dependent/blocking work, and generic docs mention customizable workflows ([jira-docs-3]). However, no first-party documentation explicitly describes subtask creation or 'blocks/is blocked by' link types, and no hands-on evidence shows the blocking-order UI in action. Missing for 10: explicit docs on subtask hierarchy, explicit 'blocks' dependency link type documentation, and independent confirmation of blocking-order visualization.
